Details 
 Step into the Wild West with our stylish engraved honey leather western boot for men, crafted from high-quality bovine leather.
- These boots represent artisanal excellence, with intricate laser-engraved geometric motifs showcasing meticulous attention to detail.
- The sleek metallic Cuadra monogram and expertly handwoven elements on the tube add sophistication and Western flair.
 Designed with both durability and comfort in mind, these boots are equipped with a leather sole that offers exceptional longevity and reliable wear. The anti-slip TPU injection provides stability for any terrain, perfect for days or nights out.
 Experience the perfect blend of traditional cowboy style and modern functionality with these premium boots. Versatile for any occasion, these boots are perfect for special events, outdoor adventures, and making a fashion statement. With their timeless design and impeccable craftsmanship, they are a testament to the rich heritage of Western footwear.
 Choose our cowboy boots and step confidently into a world where style and durability meet, ensuring that you stand out from the crowd with every step you take.
- SHAFT: 13 in.
- HEEL: 1 ⅛ in.
- TOE SHAPE: Square
